# 1. Introduction and Goals

## 1.2 Quality Goals

| Priority | Quality Goal | Scenario |
|----------|--------------|----------|
| 1 | `#reliable` Reliability | Orders survive the loss of one node |
| 2 | Efficiency (**#efficient**) | p95 checkout latency below 300 ms |
| 3 | [#secure](https://quality.arc42.org) Security | Every request is authenticated |
